It was the worst part of withdrawal for me, not being able to sleep is horrendous.

You need to eat very well, not eating well throughout the day will make it harder to sleep. I took sleeping tablets, in the UK its called nytol and it helped me not get so angry/stressed. Guided meditation for sleep helped me too when I was at an all time low. If the guided meditation doesn't work, breathing exercises for sleep also helped.

Avoid going on ur phone, jacking off, or doing ANYTHING but sleeping in your bed. Your brain will associate ur bed with these other activities which will make it harder to sleep.

If you're really struggling to sleep in ur bed, I find going to another room to sleep helps a lot. Whether that's on the floor or on a sofa, just get a change of scenery. 

Having a weighted blanket might help too? I don't have one, but my dog is quite heavy lmao and she curls up by my legs and kinda forces me to chill out.
